releaseNotes: 2.3.2: call recording no longer depends on the app's own folder on shared storage, minimal first onboarding screen with the app icon. 2.3.1: onboarding redesign, dialer suggestion and call-start fixes, Manage call list for conferences, updater and recording-graph fixes. 2.3.0: New search screen with recent searches and voice search, Trash for deleted contacts and calls, copy contacts between phone / SIM / Google / .vcf files, edit button and WhatsApp-friendly sharing, call chip timer fix, vibrate on connect / end, animated Call Insights day pages.
